2021 XACT 5448 midvalve trampoline cup v1

KTM 250/300 XC / Husqvarna TX 300 2021, XACT 5448 midvalve, setting list 34188U73. Animations of the cup and stack moving from rest, through float, to full trampoline travel at the stop collar. Each loops continuously (about 6 seconds).

1. Section drawing with controls2. Section drawing only

1. Section drawing with controls

The full panel: position buttons, Opening slider (amber while the float opens, green during trampoline travel), live readout and legend.

2. Section drawing only

The same animation cropped to the drawing: the main stack lifts off the MV piston face (float), then the trampoline stack moves into the cup until it reaches the stop collar.

Created 2026-10-18. Standalone page: the animations are embedded in this file.
